mission: Biometric school check-in: a pupil must register attendance at a fingerprint reader before the late bell.

features.label: Pupil position (x, y)
features.description: Where the pupil is standing in the courtyard.
features.source: Overhead fisheye camera with a person tracker, or a UWB tag in the student ID card

features.label: Offset and range to reader A
features.description: Vector and straight line distance to the main door reader.
features.source: Same tracker, combined with the surveyed coordinates of the kiosk from the site plan

features.label: Offset and range to reader B
features.description: Vector and distance to the east side gate reader.

features.label: Offset and range to sanitizer
features.description: Vector and distance to the hand sanitizer stand.

features.label: Offset and range to reception
features.description: Vector and distance to the reception booth.

features.label: At station flags (4)
features.description: Whether the pupil is within 0.9 m of each of the four stations.
features.source: Bluetooth Low Energy proximity beacon at each station, or a geofence over the tracker feed

features.label: Hand cleanliness
features.description: Estimated cleanliness of the finger that will be presented.
features.source: Dose counter on the sanitizer dispenser plus elapsed time, cross checked against the reader's own NFIQ image quality score

features.label: Rejections at A and B
features.description: Failed scans recorded so far at each reader.
features.source: Attendance and access control REST API, per device event log

features.label: Lockout flags A and B
features.description: Whether a reader has locked this pupil out.
features.source: Same access control API, device state field

features.label: Reader B health belief
features.description: Whether the side reader is out of service. Reads 0 until the pupil is close enough to see the display.
features.source: Device heartbeat endpoint, legible on the kiosk screen within roughly 2.5 m

features.label: Queue length at A and B
features.description: How many people are waiting at each reader.
features.source: Overhead camera people counter, or the queue display board feed

features.label: Time remaining
features.description: Fraction of the episode budget still left.

features.label: Time to the bell
features.description: Fraction of time left before the late bell. Goes negative once late.
features.source: School timetable API plus system clock

features.label: Manual sign-in available
features.description: Whether reception will accept a signature yet.

actions.name: move_north
actions.description: Walk one step (0.5 m) towards the building.

actions.name: move_south
actions.description: Walk one step away from the building.

actions.name: move_west
actions.description: Walk one step towards the gate side.

actions.name: move_east
actions.description: Walk one step towards the reader side.

actions.name: sanitize_hands
actions.description: Take a dose of sanitizer. Only works at the stand.

actions.name: scan_fingerprint
actions.description: Present a finger to a reader. Only works at a reader.

actions.name: wait_in_queue
actions.description: Stand still and let the queue ahead clear.

actions.name: request_assistance
actions.description: Call a staff member to recalibrate a reader. Takes 4 steps.

actions.name: check_in_manually
actions.description: Sign the register at reception. Only after a lockout.

rewards.shaping: potential based: DIST_W * (Phi(s') - Phi(s)), Phi = -(remaining route length), so closed loops sum to zero

endpoints.returns: state after the trained agent picks one action
